## Loading packages and data



```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(lavaan) 
library(semTools)
library(tidySEM)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(knitr)
source("./gor-covid-19/final scripts/scripts/check_admissibility.R")

# Load the data

df <- read_csv("./gor-covid-19/final scripts/data/03_data_wide.csv")
```

## Configural model

```{r}

# ============================================================
# 1. DEFINE WAVES AND ORDINAL ITEMS
# ============================================================

waves <- c(3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 12)

ord_items <- unlist(
  lapply(
    waves,
    function(w) paste0("JG_Eenzaam", 1:6, "_w", w)
  )
)

ord_items

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 2. BASE CONFIGURAL MODEL
# ============================================================


base.model <- '

  # ----- Factors per wave -----

  el_w3  =~ JG_Eenzaam1_w3  + JG_Eenzaam2_w3  + JG_Eenzaam3_w3 +
            JG_Eenzaam4_w3  + JG_Eenzaam5_w3  + JG_Eenzaam6_w3

  el_w4  =~ JG_Eenzaam1_w4  + JG_Eenzaam2_w4  + JG_Eenzaam3_w4 +
            JG_Eenzaam4_w4  + JG_Eenzaam5_w4  + JG_Eenzaam6_w4

  el_w5  =~ JG_Eenzaam1_w5  + JG_Eenzaam2_w5  + JG_Eenzaam3_w5 +
            JG_Eenzaam4_w5  + JG_Eenzaam5_w5  + JG_Eenzaam6_w5

  el_w6  =~ JG_Eenzaam1_w6  + JG_Eenzaam2_w6  + JG_Eenzaam3_w6 +
            JG_Eenzaam4_w6  + JG_Eenzaam5_w6  + JG_Eenzaam6_w6

  el_w7  =~ JG_Eenzaam1_w7  + JG_Eenzaam2_w7  + JG_Eenzaam3_w7 +
            JG_Eenzaam4_w7  + JG_Eenzaam5_w7  + JG_Eenzaam6_w7

  el_w8  =~ JG_Eenzaam1_w8  + JG_Eenzaam2_w8  + JG_Eenzaam3_w8 +
            JG_Eenzaam4_w8  + JG_Eenzaam5_w8  + JG_Eenzaam6_w8

  el_w10 =~ JG_Eenzaam1_w10 + JG_Eenzaam2_w10 + JG_Eenzaam3_w10 +
            JG_Eenzaam4_w10 + JG_Eenzaam5_w10 + JG_Eenzaam6_w10

  el_w12 =~ JG_Eenzaam1_w12 + JG_Eenzaam2_w12 + JG_Eenzaam3_w12 +
            JG_Eenzaam4_w12 + JG_Eenzaam5_w12 + JG_Eenzaam6_w12


  # ----- Within-wave residual covariance item 1 ~~ item 4 -----

  JG_Eenzaam1_w3  ~~ JG_Eenzaam4_w3
  JG_Eenzaam1_w4  ~~ JG_Eenzaam4_w4
  JG_Eenzaam1_w5  ~~ JG_Eenzaam4_w5
  JG_Eenzaam1_w6  ~~ JG_Eenzaam4_w6
  JG_Eenzaam1_w7  ~~ JG_Eenzaam4_w7
  JG_Eenzaam1_w8  ~~ JG_Eenzaam4_w8
  JG_Eenzaam1_w10 ~~ JG_Eenzaam4_w10
  JG_Eenzaam1_w12 ~~ JG_Eenzaam4_w12
  
'

```



```{r}
# ============================================================
# 3. TELL semTools WHICH FACTORS ARE REPEATED MEASURES
# ============================================================

longFacNames <- list(
  loneliness = c(
    "el_w3",
    "el_w4",
    "el_w5",
    "el_w6",
    "el_w7",
    "el_w8",
    "el_w10",
    "el_w12"
  )
)
```


```{r}

# ============================================================
# 4. CONFIGURAL MODEL
# ============================================================

syntax.config <- measEq.syntax(
  configural.model = base.model,
  data = df,
  ordered = ord_items,
  ID.fac = "std.lv",
  ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
  longFacNames = longFacNames,
  long.equal = "",
  auto = "all"
)

# Inspect generated syntax
summary(syntax.config)
cat(as.character(syntax.config))
```

```{r}
# Fit configural model
config.fit <- cfa(
  model = as.character(syntax.config),
  data = df,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  ordered = ord_items,
  missing = "pairwise"
)


summary(config.fit)
```


Check the modindices 

```{r}
print(head(modindices(config.fit, sort. = TRUE), 30))
```

Check admissability of the solution

```{r}
print(lavInspect(config.fit, "post.check"))
res <- check_admissibility(config.fit)
print(res)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5. THRESHOLD-EQUALITY MODEL
# ============================================================

syntax.threshold <- measEq.syntax(
  configural.model = base.model,
  data = df,
  ordered = ord_items,
  ID.fac = "std.lv",
  ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
  longFacNames = longFacNames,
  long.equal = "thresholds",
  auto = "all"
)

summary(syntax.threshold)
cat(as.character(syntax.threshold))
```


```{r}
threshold.fit <- cfa(
  model = as.character(syntax.threshold),
  data = df,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  ordered = ord_items,
  missing = "pairwise"
)


summary(threshold.fit)
```


Check admissability of the solution

```{r}
print(lavInspect(threshold.fit, "post.check"))
res <- check_admissibility(threshold.fit)
print(res)
```


```{r}

# ============================================================
# 6. METRIC INVARIANCE
# ============================================================
#
# Equal thresholds + equal loadings

syntax.metric <- measEq.syntax(
  configural.model = base.model,
  data = df,
  ordered = ord_items,
  ID.fac = "std.lv",
  ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
  longFacNames = longFacNames,
  long.equal = c(
    "thresholds",
    "loadings"
  ),
  auto = "all"
)

summary(syntax.metric)
cat(as.character(syntax.metric))
```

```{r}
metric.fit <- cfa(
  model = as.character(syntax.metric),
  data = df,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  ordered = ord_items,
  missing = "pairwise"
)


#metric.fit <- readRDS("./gor-covid-19/final scripts/models/metric_model_loneliness.rds")

summary(metric.fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

Check admissability


```{r}
print(lavInspect(metric.fit, "post.check"))
res <- check_admissibility(metric.fit)
print(res)
```

Compare fit with threshold model 

```{r}
fit.comparison.metric <- compareFit(threshold.fit, metric.fit)
summary(fit.comparison.metric)
```



```{r}


# ============================================================
# 7. SCALAR / STRONG INVARIANCE
# ============================================================
#
# Equal thresholds + loadings + intercepts

syntax.scalar <- measEq.syntax(
  configural.model = base.model,
  data = df,
  ordered = ord_items,
  ID.fac = "std.lv",
  ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",
  longFacNames = longFacNames,
  long.equal = c(
    "thresholds",
    "loadings",
    "intercepts"
  ),
  auto = "all"
)

summary(syntax.scalar)
cat(as.character(syntax.scalar))
```


```{r}
scalar.fit <- cfa(
  model = as.character(syntax.scalar),
  data = df,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  ordered = ord_items,
  missing = "pairwise"
)


#scalar.fit <- readRDS("./gor-covid-19/final scripts/models/scalar_model_loneliness.rds")
summary(scalar.fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```


Check admissibility 

```{r}
print(lavInspect(scalar.fit, "post.check"))

res <- check_admissibility(scalar.fit)
print(res)
```

Compare the metric fit with the scalar fit

```{r}
fit.comparison.metric <- compareFit(metric.fit, scalar.fit)
summary(fit.comparison.metric)
```

##Comparing all fits for table 
```{r}
comp <- compareFit(config.fit, threshold.fit, metric.fit, scalar.fit)
summary(comp)
```

##Tables with loadings etc. 

```{r, results='asis'}
loneliness_models <- list(
  config    = config.fit,
  threshold = threshold.fit,
  metric    = metric.fit,
  scalar    = scalar.fit
)

saveRDS(
  loneliness_models,
  "./gor-covid-19/final scripts/models/loneliness_1factor_models.rds"
)

cat("## Configural model\n\n")
config_table <- table_results(
  config.fit,
  columns = c(
    "label",
    "est_sig",
    "se",
    "pval",
    "confint"
  ),
  digits = 3
)



ft_config <- flextable(config_table) |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit() |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
  align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  valign(valign = "center", part = "all")


save_as_docx(
  "Configural model" = ft_config,
  path = "./gor-covid-19/final scripts/Tables/configural_model_table_loneliness.docx"
)
print(ft_config)
```

##Saving factor predictions of scalar model

```{r}
predictions <- lavPredict(scalar.fit)
print(nrow(predictions))
print(nrow(df))
df_pred <- cbind(df, as.data.frame(predictions))
df_pred %>%  
  write_csv("./gor-covid-19/final scripts/data/04_data_wide_loneliness.csv")
```

##Saving factor predictions long format

```{r}
df_pred_long <- df_pred %>%
  select(
    Koppelnummer,
    el_w3, el_w4, el_w5, el_w6,
    el_w7, el_w8, el_w10, el_w12
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("el_w"),
    names_to = "Ronde",
    names_prefix = "el_w",
    values_to = "el_fct"
  ) %>%
  mutate(wave = as.integer(Ronde)) %>%  
  write_csv("./gor-covid-19/final scripts/data/04_loneliness_fct.csv")
```
